_comment: Product-side source policy for the deployed OFBiz release.
The allow list names only the declarative descriptors parsed by sourcemap.py, so the
attested surface digest covers exactly the bytes used to derive a SourceMap. The deny
list excludes credentials, runtime data, uploads, demo data and test truth regardless
of an allowed parent path. The package tests enforce both boundaries mechanically.
The deployment supplies the matching source root and expected application version.
